A **backlink** is an automatic list of every page that links to the current page.

## How backlinks work

Rendering your site, quarto-graph:

1. Scans all wikilinks across your pages
2. For each target page, collects all pages linking to it
3. Appends a "Backlinks" section at the bottom of that page
4. Sorts the list alphabetically by page title

Both this page and [[The Graph Widget]] link here from [[quarto-graph|the home page]] and each other. Scroll to the bottom to see the backlinks list.

## What counts as a backlink

Backlinks are created only from **wikilinks** (the double-bracket syntax):

- `[[Backlinks]]` counts as a backlink
- `[Backlinks](./backlinks.qmd)` does NOT count

Backlinks and [[The Graph Widget|graph edges]] are generated from the same scan, so they always stay in sync.

## How backlinks appear

The backlinks section is injected at render time by a Pandoc Lua filter. It's never written to your `.qmd` source files. For example:

```markdown
## Backlinks

- [The Graph Widget](../the-graph-widget/index.qmd)
- [quarto-graph](../index.qmd)
```
